title: Hope is the thing with feathers (Emily Dickinson)
body:
"Hope" is the thing with feathers -
That perches in the soul -
And sings the tune without the words -
And never stops - at all -

And sweetest - in the Gale - is heard -
And sore must be the storm -
That could abash the little Bird
That kept so many warm -
rationale: Verbatim recitation emits one exact-recall card per non-empty source line (see verbatim_candidates/sequential_units), independent of the bounded procedure-prose fallback cap. This stanza has 8 lines, so 8 drafts is the correct exhaustive-per-line count by design, not count inflation; max_drafts was raised from 6 to 8 to match. No other fixture's range was widened for this change.
